skills.name: production-task
skills.purpose: Resolve owner intent into bounded ownership, dependencies, resumable state and evidence handoffs.
skills.trigger: New multi-step task, controlled revision or resume.
skills.gate: Identity, exclusive writer, permission scope and duplicate-job/restart fixtures pass; decisions remain separately attributed.
skills.human_authority: Pram sets scope, spend, creative decisions and release approval.
skills.reason_separate: Coordinates state across gameplay and art without granting wca-orchestrate game authority.

skills.name: runtime-contract
skills.purpose: Bind canonical rules/data and version migrations to authoritative C++ and generated engine parity.
skills.trigger: Hero, trait, relic, command, save or protocol changes.
skills.gate: Schema/generation checks, rule invariants and affected native/engine parity; authored behavior is not executed until matching tests pass.
skills.human_authority: Pram approves product-contract changes and migration scope.
skills.reuse_level: generic contracts + Unreal adapter + game policy
skills.reason_separate: Runtime rule authority and compatibility require a distinct contract from art integration.

skills.name: gameplay-experiment
skills.purpose: Preregister and analyze legal-acquisition, formation, pacing and representative bot-policy experiments.
skills.trigger: A falsifiable gameplay/balance hypothesis or evidence-needed design decision.
skills.gate: Reconciled event data, policy variation, declared holdout and sample/uncertainty report; no human-enjoyment claim from bots.
skills.human_authority: Pram chooses design tradeoffs; human study required for experience acceptance.
skills.reuse_level: generic experiment framework + game metric/command adapters
skills.reason_separate: Experimental inference is different from source validation and must prevent overfitting.

skills.name: player-journey
skills.purpose: Specify, implement and physically verify one complete interaction with feedback, accessibility and localization.
skills.trigger: Shop, bench, relic, recap, settings, save/load or later lobby journey changes.
skills.gate: Normal/rejected/cutoff/recovery paths, pointer/keyboard, required resolutions/text/languages; first-use study remains separate.
skills.human_authority: Pram sets product scope; eligible users establish comprehension.
skills.reuse_level: generic journey contract + Unreal interface adapter + game task policy
skills.disposition: new; preserve wca-ui as art specialist
skills.reason_separate: Static UI art cannot own interaction state, focus, input or complete player flows.

skills.name: human-study
skills.purpose: Prepare and analyze assistance-aware comprehension, pacing and repeat-use studies on exact builds.
skills.trigger: B1/B2/M5 experience gates or a preregistered usability question.
skills.gate: Protocol/build fixed, assistance/missing/withdrawal fixtures pass; actual eligible sessions required for human conclusions.
skills.human_authority: Pram authorizes recruitment; participants provide observations; no agent invents acceptance.
skills.reuse_level: generic research operators + project gate policy
skills.reason_separate: Human evidence, eligibility and inference limits must remain independent of implementation success.

skills.name: creature-delivery
skills.purpose: Qualify and resume the selected Meshy→Unreal colored, textured, anatomy-specific animation-ready delivery.
skills.trigger: One new authorized creature delivery or affected revision of a preserved candidate.
skills.gate: Anatomy-specific stress/skin contact/cold reopen and actual visual review; combined human forms/color/rig gate remains intact.
skills.human_authority: Pram approves affected likeness/color/rig scope and paid jobs; unchanged approvals persist.
skills.reuse_level: generic anatomy contract + Unreal adapter + family recipes
skills.reason_separate: Unsupported anatomy, provider-surface differences and weight/contact evidence need coordinated delivery.

skills.name: motion-events
skills.purpose: Author and verify continuous creature motion and event-driven VFX/audio without changing rule timing.
skills.trigger: Combat clips/transitions/cues or authoritative timing/rest-pose revisions.
skills.gate: Actual continuous motion, contact, cancellation/release/death sync, overlap/reduced effects and packaged listening.
skills.human_authority: Pram accepts creative motion/audio; runtime validators enforce event identity.
skills.reuse_level: generic event contract + Unreal adapters + locomotion recipes
skills.reason_separate: The legacy Blender assumption must not override the creature route or become a second combat authority.

skills.name: exact-build
skills.purpose: Create exact, recoverable study/release packages with scoped installation, performance and acceptance evidence.
skills.trigger: Candidate promotion, study distribution or final release freeze.
skills.gate: Affected regression/parity, exact freeze and required clean-checkout/clean-machine/whole-game gates; asset promotion remains wca-release.
skills.human_authority: Pram accepts final product and separately authorizes game publication.
skills.reuse_level: generic evidence operations + Unreal packaging + game gate policy
skills.reason_separate: Whole-game readiness, install and source identity are wider than an asset promotion gate.

skills.name: identity-reference
skills.purpose: Preserve canonical creature/world identity and qualified art/reference routes.
skills.trigger: New approved brief/reference or affected likeness revision.
skills.gate: Actual views/asymmetry and gameplay-camera identity reviewed; selected Krita and existing approval tolerance preserved.
skills.human_authority: Pram chooses creative direction and exact G2 acceptance.
skills.reuse_level: generic reference operators + game style policy
skills.reason_separate: Identity and reference acceptance precede source production and avoid lore drift.

skills.name: environment-render
skills.purpose: Deliver measured board modules, camera/lighting/material readability and mixed-content performance.
skills.trigger: Wondergrove module/shared-look/camera or platform representation changes.
skills.gate: Measured dimensions/pivots/seams/collision, unobstructed tactical view, actual mixed-content capture/profile and affected owner review.
skills.human_authority: Pram accepts board/look scope and supported target devices.
skills.reuse_level: generic assembly/budget validators + Unreal adapter + board recipe
skills.reason_separate: Board assembly and whole-screen tactical readability require integration beyond individual meshes.

skills.name: effects
skills.purpose: Produce bounded event-driven readable effects and reduced-effects behavior.
skills.trigger: New cue, overlap defect or effect budget/timing change.
skills.gate: No authority divergence; ownership/cancel/expiry/overlap and reduced-effects cues actually reviewed.
skills.human_authority: Pram accepts affected visual grammar; no new mechanic inferred.
skills.reuse_level: generic cue validators + Unreal effect adapter + game grammar
skills.reason_separate: Effect lifetimes/pooling/readability have distinct failure modes from animation authoring.

skills.name: audio
skills.purpose: Create/integrate rights-cleared sonic identity, repeated cues, ambience and modest music scope.
skills.trigger: Sound delivery, mix/rights gap or competing-cue defect.
skills.gate: Actual listening in repeated/overlapping packaged mix, no clipping/masking of critical cues, rights/source/version records.
skills.human_authority: Pram accepts sonic direction, licensing/spend and voice scope.
skills.reuse_level: generic rights/listening contracts + Unreal audio adapter + sonic policy
skills.reason_separate: Licensing, listening and mix behavior cannot be established by visual/mesh checks.

skills.name: asset-knowledge
skills.purpose: Build a small local-first Wonder Atlas index joining existing authorities with stale-preview detection.
skills.trigger: Owner cannot find/resume/review a candidate or a source/preview revision changes.
skills.gate: Rebuild preserves annotations; latest/approved distinct; source change marks only affected previews stale; allowlisted publication.
skills.human_authority: Pram controls review decisions and export/publication scope.
skills.reason_separate: Search/derivatives are rebuildable and must not become another game database.

skills.name: network-session
skills.purpose: Implement and qualify applicable dedicated-server/authenticated-session, reconnect and service failure behavior.
skills.trigger: M6 prerequisites ready or a remote/session/privacy defect.
skills.human_authority: Pram approves paid/public operations and supported remote scope.
skills.disposition: new around existing native authority tests
skills.reason_separate: Service identity/operations/device evidence is not equivalent to native protocol fixtures.

skills.name: publishing-support
skills.purpose: Prepare truthful rights/platform/distribution/support materials and recoverable post-launch updates.
skills.trigger: Accepted release scope approaches publication or a supported player issue/update.
skills.gate: Actual install/support reproduction, scope-correct claims, rights and applicable platform requirements checked; explicit publication authorization.
skills.human_authority: Pram accepts legal/platform commitments, public messaging and publication.
skills.reuse_level: generic release/support checklists + platform adapters + product policy
skills.reason_separate: Public distribution, rights, communication and support persist beyond packaging.

skills.name: ecosystem-content
skills.purpose: Translate accepted creative/game pillars into coherent earned hero/trait/relic/neutral batches and world identity.
skills.trigger: A measured strategic gap or new approved content contract.
skills.gate: Distinct ordinary-acquisition strategy/counter, useful/unfavorable formations and actual runtime tests/human acceptance; no fixed final roster cap.
skills.human_authority: Pram controls pillars, creative identity and earned content promotion.
skills.reuse_level: generic decision/coverage framework + Wonder Chess design policy
skills.reason_separate: Content design and scope decisions precede execution; they must not be hidden inside art or code wrappers.
